roles.title: Aerodynamics
roles.description: Bodywork and cooling flow for a first-year car. Our benchmarking says no full aero package in season one — so the work is clean bodywork, radiator duct design and the CFD to justify it.
lookingFor: Willingness to learn a solver from scratch — we will teach you
Interest in fluid mechanics or thermal design
Patience with meshes that will not converge

roles.title: Chassis & Driver Ergonomics
roles.description: The steel spaceframe, the driver cell and everything about fitting a human safely inside it. This subteam owns the Structural Equivalency Spreadsheet the competition requires.
lookingFor: CAD ability, or the willingness to get there quickly
Comfortable in a workshop with PPE
Methodical about documentation — the SES is judged on it

roles.title: Steering
roles.description: Rack, column, wheel and the geometry that connects them. Currently a one-person subteam, which makes this one of the largest gaps on the car.
lookingFor: Mechanical design interest; no prior experience expected
Happy to own a subsystem end to end
Willing to defend a design decision to a judge

roles.title: Suspension
roles.description: Wishbones, uprights, springs and dampers, and the kinematics that decide how the car behaves. Also a one-person subteam right now.
lookingFor: Interest in vehicle dynamics
Comfortable with CAD and hand calculations
Prepared to validate a model against a real measurement

roles.title: Throttle & Braking Systems
roles.description: Pedal box, brake system and the throttle position sensing an electric car needs. Safety-critical work that scrutineers inspect closely.
lookingFor: Precise, careful approach — this is safety-critical
Interest in mechanical design or sensors
No prior motorsport experience needed

roles.title: Powertrain & Drivetrain
roles.description: Motor mounting, the single-stage chain drive, the differential and the final drive ratio — sized from lap simulation rather than copied from another team's car.
lookingFor: Interest in transmissions, or in simulation
Comfortable turning a requirement into a number
Mechanical or electrical background both welcome

roles.title: High Voltage
roles.description: The accumulator, the tractive system and every safety interlock around them. This subteam owns the Electrical System Form and works directly with the Electrical System Officer.
lookingFor: Electrical engineering background, or serious intent to learn
Absolute discipline around safety procedure
Interest in battery systems and power electronics

roles.title: Low Voltage & Controls
roles.description: The loom, the shutdown circuit, the dashboard and the logging that tells us what the car actually did. Everything from CAN bus to the driver display.
lookingFor: Any C, C++ or Python — embedded experience not expected
Interest in real-time systems or instrumentation
Happy to debug hardware, not just code
